registrySnapshot.authority: App-owned design collection, tokens and optional inventory

limitations: Synthetic previews only; production authentication, services and private data are not included.
Original-work ownership remains unchanged. Frontend code and listed design assets are inspectable by visitors.
Hosting must supply Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for opaque allow-scripts-only frames.
No source maps, credentials, environment loading, private commit revisions or public network requests.
